display.title: Episode 2: The Search, Little Avraham (Yud-Tes Kislev)
display.summary_short: On Yud-Tes Kislev, Uncle Yossi teaches about the Hebrew calendar and the Alter Rebbe's release, and tells how little Avraham searched for and found the one true G-d.
display.summary_long: Broadcast on Yud-Tes Kislev 5742. The show opens with a lively march and thanks for the many letters from listeners. Uncle Yossi asks children to send in riddles and to be proud of their Hebrew names, then plays a guessing game: what has twelve pages, boxes of numbers and a new page every month? A calendar. That leads to the Hebrew calendar and today's date, the 19th of Kislev, when the Alter Rebbe, jailed for teaching Torah, was freed by a miracle. After a listener's letter asks to say the Shema together again, everyone does. Story time is "The Search": three-year-old Avraham looks for the Creator, wonders whether the sun or the moon is G-d, sees them set, and realizes that the true G-d cannot be seen and is everywhere. He grew up to be Avraham Avinu, the first Jew. The show ends looking ahead to Chanukah that Sunday night, with a number to call for a free Chanukah kit.
display.lesson: Hashem made the sun, the moon and the stars; He cannot be seen, yet He is everywhere and keeps the world alive every moment.

date.note: 'Today is the 19th day of the month of Kislev'; Chanukah begins 'this Sunday night'. Matches the weekly estimate.

advisories.note: The Alter Rebbe was jailed for teaching Torah and his life was in danger.
